logline: Rupert and Catherine frame Juliana for poisoning the Duchess despite the bedridden matriarch's protests, uncovering Juliana's true noble identity and her mother's herbarium before ordering her to the castle dungeons.
continuity_notes: Picks up directly from Episode 27 as Rupert orders the guard to seize Juliana, ignoring the waking Duchess.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot as the guard drags Juliana toward the doorway, wrestling her backward.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Juliana struggles against the guard's grip; the leather-bound herbarium slips from her apron pocket and falls to the stone floor.

events.label: SOUND FX
events.content: Heavy thud of the leather journal hitting the polished floor.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Low-angle close-up of the leather-bound herbarium on the floor as Catherine's silk slipper steps down hard upon its embossed cover.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Catherine plants her embroidered shoe deliberately atop the fallen book.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium two-shot tracking Catherine as she strides gracefully across the chamber toward Juliana, Rupert standing stoically behind her near the bed.

events.label: CATHERINE (Mocking, Cruel)
events.content: "Look at her, Rupert."

events.label: CATHERINE (Scoffing)
events.content: "Soot on her face..."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Over-the-shoulder shot from behind Catherine as she faces Juliana, who is pinned in the doorway by the guard.

events.label: CATHERINE (Accusing, Smug)
events.content: "...herbs in her pockets..."

events.label: CATHERINE (Cold)
events.content: "...a secret medicine in her hand."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Tight close-up of Catherine's smiling face, her eyes gleaming with vindictive pleasure.

events.label: CATHERINE (Venomous)
events.content: "She looks exactly like a poisoner."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Juliana glaring back in fierce indignation, breathing heavily as she resists the guard's arm across her shoulder.

events.label: JULIANA (Furious, Defiant)
events.content: "I did not poison her! Look at her eyes, the fever has broken!"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium full shot of Rupert standing beside the four-poster bed, calmly pulling on his black leather gloves.

events.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Sardonic, Chilling)
events.content: "A clever story, girl."

events.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Threatening)
events.content: "But the guards know how to extract the truth."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up of the Dowager Duchess stirring against her pillows, lifting her trembling head with visible effort.

events.label: DOWAGER DUCHESS (Weak, Straining)
events.content: "Rupert..."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot of Rupert pausing mid-stride as he hears his mother's voice, slowly turning his head toward the bed.

events.label: DOWAGER DUCHESS (O.S.) (Commanding)
events.content: "Stop this!"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Wide shot of the bedchamber framed through the bed curtains as the Duchess props herself up on one elbow and points an accusing finger.

events.label: DOWAGER DUCHESS (Desperate, Firm)
events.content: "She is innocent."

events.label: DOWAGER DUCHESS (Adamant)
events.content: "She saved me!"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Juliana, tears of relief welling in her eyes.

events.label: JULIANA (Breathless, Relieved)
events.content: "Your Grace..."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of the Duchess clutching at her nightgown, her face twisted in mounting fury and horror.

events.label: DOWAGER DUCHESS (Trembling, Shouting)
events.content: "I know what happened to me!"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium low-angle shot past the Duchess pointing directly at Rupert, who stands rigid and expressionless.

events.label: DOWAGER DUCHESS (Fierce, Condemning)
events.content: "I was poisoned!"

events.label: DOWAGER DUCHESS (Accusing)
events.content: "And you... you knew!"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot of the Duchess lunging forward from the pillows, gasping for breath as she points toward Catherine.

events.label: DOWAGER DUCHESS (Choking, Weakening)
events.content: "Catherine knew!"

events.label: DOWAGER DUCHESS (Gasping)
events.content: "They have been—"

events.label: ACTION
events.content: The Duchess collapses back onto the pillows, coughing violently and clutching her chest.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Wide shot as Juliana lunges across the room toward the bed, but the armed guard seizes her from behind and drags her back.

events.label: JULIANA (Panicked, Screaming)
events.content: "Let me help her!"

events.label: JULIANA (Desperate)
events.content: "She's still weak, you cannot leave her like this!"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up of Rupert smoothing down his black leather gloves, a chilling smile forming on his lips.

events.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Smooth, Feigning Concern)
events.content: "You see?"

events.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Sinister)
events.content: "The poison has clearly damaged her mind."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Over-the-shoulder shot of Rupert leaning menacingly over the gasping Duchess in bed.

events.label: DOWAGER DUCHESS (Hoarse, Straining)
events.content: "I am not delusional!"

events.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Condescending, Whispering)
events.content: "Of course you are not."

events.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Dismissive)
events.content: "You are merely confused."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium profile tracking shot of Catherine walking deliberately toward Juliana, speaking with airy cynicism.

events.label: CATHERINE (Amused, Mocking)
events.content: "How convenient that the only person who can prove the poison exists..."

events.label: CATHERINE (Smug)
events.content: "...is the maid who claims to have discovered it."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Low-angle medium shot of Rupert turning sharply toward the guard, his eyes icy and authoritative.

events.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Commanding, Resolute)
events.content: "Take her away before she poisons the rest of this house."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Tight close-up of Catherine's gloved hands grabbing the delicate chain around Juliana's neck.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Catherine ruthlessly yanks the silver locket off Juliana's neck.

events.label: JULIANA (Crying Out)
events.content: "No!"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up of Catherine holding up the oval silver and amethyst pendant, inspecting it with disdain.

events.label: CATHERINE (Insolent, Sneering)
events.content: "Where did a gutter rat like you find a silver locket?"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Juliana crying out in agony, writhing in the guard's iron grip.

events.label: JULIANA (Screaming, Weeping)
events.content: "Give it back!"

events.label: JULIANA (Anguished)
events.content: "It belonged to my mother!"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Low-angle shot tracking the silver locket as Catherine casually flings it across the stone corridor floor.

events.label: CATHERINE (O.S.) (Cruel)
events.content: "A witch has no need for family heirlooms in the gallows."

events.label: SOUND FX
events.content: Metallic clatter as the silver pendant bounces against the wooden baseboard.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot of Juliana being dragged further into the doorway, staring helplessly toward her discarded locket.

events.label: JULIANA (Heartbroken)
events.content: "My mother's locket!"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot of Catherine walking toward the fallen leather-bound book and kneeling gracefully to pick it up.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Catherine lifts the heavy herbarium, dusting off the cover before opening its aged parchment pages.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Tight close-up of Catherine reading the elegant cursive script inside the front cover.

events.label: CATHERINE (Intrigued, Murmuring)
events.content: "Juliana..."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Extreme close-up on the handwritten inscription: 'Juliana Ashcroft'.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot of Juliana freezing in the doorway as she sees Catherine opening her mother's book.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Juliana gasps in horror, realizing her secret identity has been laid bare.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Catherine raising her gaze slowly from the book, a wicked, triumphant grin spreading across her face.

events.label: CATHERINE (Triumphant, Venomous)
events.content: "Lady Juliana Ashcroft."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium two-shot as Catherine steps deliberately up to Juliana, circling her like a predator savoring its prey.

events.label: CATHERINE (Mocking, Reveling)
events.content: "I knew I had seen those eyes before."

events.label: CATHERINE (Cruel)
events.content: "The disgraced daughter..."

events.label: CATHERINE (Scornful)
events.content: "...the girl thrown out of her own family home."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up two-shot of Catherine leaning inches from Juliana's face, whispering her humiliating past.

events.label: CATHERINE (Taunting)
events.content: "The bride who married a penniless war veteran..."

events.label: CATHERINE (Vicious)
events.content: "...because no respectable man would have her."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Tight close-up of Juliana's eyes blazing with explosive fury and defensive loyalty.

events.label: JULIANA (Screaming, Wildly Defiant)
events.content: "Do not speak about my husband!"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium two-shot as Catherine throws her head back in derisive laughter, brandishing the herbarium book.

events.label: CATHERINE (Laughing, Scornful)
events.content: "And look at you now. Scrubbing fireplaces in my house."

events.label: CATHERINE (Mocking)
events.content: "What a magnificent fall, Lady Juliana."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot of Rupert gesturing toward the exit with an outstretched arm.

events.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Harsh, Authoritative)
events.content: "Drag her to the wet cells beneath the south tower."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Catherine fanning open the illustrated botanical pages of the herbarium with gloved fingers.

events.label: CATHERINE (Smug)
events.content: "And this?"

events.label: CATHERINE (Gleeful)
events.content: "This book of weeds will hang her before the magistrate."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot of Juliana thrashing frantically against the guard's grip, her arm reaching out toward the book.

events.label: JULIANA (Screaming, Desperate)
events.content: "That book is my mother's life's work!"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up of Catherine smiling coldly, clutching the closed book against her bodice.

events.label: CATHERINE (Icy, Threatening)
events.content: "Then perhaps you can explain every page to the magistrate..."

events.label: CATHERINE (Fateful, Vengeful)
events.content: "...before he sends you to the gallows."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Extreme close-up of Juliana's wide, trembling eyes as the guard wrenches her backward into the dark hallway, cutting sharply to black.

analysis_metadata.note: No invented LLM scene metadata; event-level evidence drives promo selection.
